verdict.rationale: Manufact documents connecting an already-hosted MCP server by pasting its URL, with no deploy required and an optional Manufact proxy. That is for servers 'hosting elsewhere' at a reachable URL, not for bridging a server running locally. No tunnel or local-bridge capability is documented. The local CLI dev mode (hot reload + inspector) stays local, so exposing a localhost server would need a user-side tunnel, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bridge a locally running MCP server into the platform as a managed remote connection without deploying it
